title: DIY carpentry
description: allows you to build whit more realism!
body:
Tired of flimsy structures and wasting precious resources? This mod offers a more realistic and economical approach to building in your Minecraft world. Experience the satisfaction of working with sturdy materials and discover clever ways to maximize your building potential. Stay tuned for exciting new tools and features in future updates!

Key Features:
Indestructible Reinforced Concrete: Need a foundation that can withstand anything? Reinforced concrete is incredibly strong and can only be demolished with a giant hammer. Perfect for solid foundations and long-lasting structures.
Durable Wooden Planks (with Nails or Screws): Upgrade your wooden constructions with these significantly stronger planks. Choose between the classic nail strength or use the new drill to drive screws for even more stability.
Efficient Masonry with the Trowel: Transform raw concrete into sturdy brick blocks! The trowel allows you to create durable and aesthetically pleasing brick structures at a low cost.
The Essential Drill: Say goodbye to tedious hammering! The Drill provides a quick and efficient way to install screws, ensuring your wooden structures are sturdy and secure.
Improved Woodworking with Treated Planks: Discover new possibilities for your wooden creations! Treat regular wooden planks to create unique and improved Minecraft objects.
Improved Crafting: Discover a more intuitive and efficient crafting system for vanilla objects, making your building workflow smoother and more enjoyable.

Coming soon:
   More advanced wood treatments and recipes
   More woodworking tools to expand your crafting possibilities!
   
Start building smarter, not harder! Download this mod today and revolutionize your Minecraft building experience!
